findings.claim: The graded final allots 50 minutes for the 40-item MCQ part ('a 40-item, 50-minute MCQ', with durationMinutes 200 = 150 practical + 50 MCQ at line 171), i.e. 1.25 minutes per question. The captain's final timing decision of 2026-11-09 for course final MCQs allots 2 minutes per question (30 questions get 60 minutes, 45 questions get 90 minutes, at most 45 questions). 40 items therefore require an 80-minute allotment; 50 minutes under-times the graded sitting by 37.5% and makes the assessment unfair relative to the governing rule.

evidence.section: instructions and durationMinutes of the final blueprint

findings.recommendation: Set the MCQ part to 80 minutes (durationMinutes 230) and update the instructions text, or reduce the item count so that count x 2 minutes equals the allotted time (25 items for 50 minutes), choosing the count from objective coverage per the captain's decision.
